lines.en: I hang from a leaf, unable to move.
I sway, pushed by the wind.
Something moves inside me.
I sway on the leaf's vein.
I cannot walk, and need not.
I turn a very little.
My shell hardens day by day.
The leaf veins press against me.
I hang from a thread, upside down.
I am not dead. I am waiting.
I am slowly growing.
The leaf tip bends a little.
One gust and I sway along.

lines.zh: 里面那对翅膀，快成形了。
lines.en: The wings inside are nearly formed.
Only green light reaches inside my shell.
I only know it is bright outside.
Inside the shell it is very quiet.

lines.zh: 这段时间，我什么都不做。
lines.en: For now I do nothing at all.
My body is being rebuilt.
Birds call near; I shrink tighter.
I feel the temperature.
There is a line on my shell.
I will stay here a while.
Do not shake this leaf; I would fall.
It is cramped in here.
I gather all my strength into my wings.
This seam will open on its own.

lines.zh: 我挂在森林的叶下，等羽化。
lines.en: Under a forest leaf I wait to emerge.
I hang beneath a leaf and cannot see you.
I am not a grub. Do not pinch me.
Your fingertip is too close.

lines.zh: 蛹壳里，我在重新拼自己。
lines.en: Inside the chrysalis, I am rebuilding myself.
One touch and I will fall.
I cannot fly yet.
Can you tell what I am?
The shell is thin enough to show wing veins.
Be patient.
I am more impatient than you.
The wind shakes the leaf stem badly.

lines.zh: 我用尾钩死死挂住叶柄。
lines.en: My tail hook grips the stem.
A crack opens and shows a wing tip.
I curl up inside my shell.
That jolt was too strong.
I hang from the branch, shell still hard.
Any worse and it is over.
I endure it.
The thread still holds.
I tighten my shell until it passes.
A pupa takes no nectar, only waits.
You hold a flower; my shell stays still.
I do not even have a mouth yet.
I smell nectar even through the shell.
It does not stop me. It is only in the way.
I have no mouth for your food.
Take the flower away; I only wait.

lines.zh: 我壳里还什么都没长好。
lines.en: Nothing in this shell has finished growing.
What I want is time.
You cannot give me that.
You hit the leaf.
The leaf swings hard from the bump.
My thread still holds.
I nearly fell.
Hanging under a forest leaf.
I cling to the leaf.
You walked past and stirred the air.
I will remember that jolt.
Gently.
I have a long while to hang yet.
I cannot discuss that now.
I cannot even push out my antennae.
Wait until my wings dry.
Another chrysalis is on the next leaf.

lines.zh: 孔雀蛱蝶的蛹，挂在叶背。
lines.en: A peacock chrysalis hangs under a leaf.
It formed earlier than I.
We are both silent.
The wind comes and we sway together.
In a few days we will both be out.
We will meet then.
I cannot pick anything up.

lines.zh: 有东西掉在我的叶子下。
lines.en: Something fell under my leaf.

lines.zh: 我看不见，只听见它落地。
lines.en: I cannot see; I only hear it land.
It rests on the leaf vein.
Too heavy. The leaf is bending.
That berry falls past my leaf.
I do not know what it was.
It landed in the grass.
You will have to fetch it.
Ask when I can fly.

lines.zh: 我在叶下吊着，等翅膀干。
lines.en: I hang under a leaf, waiting for wings.
A shadow passes under my leaf.
I cannot dodge.
This thin shell is all I have.
I am hanging high enough.
The leaf is above me.
I hang below the leaf; nobody touch it.
Any closer and I fall.
Then let me fall.

lines.zh: 我壳里的翅膀，还没撑开。
lines.en: The wings in my shell aren't spread yet.
I stay glued to the leaf vein.
It has not touched me.
I sway with the wind.
One more sunny day is all I need.
I hang from the leaf, waiting for my wings to dry.

lines.zh: 我在等壳变透的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for my shell to turn clear.
There is a crack in the shell.
The wings inside are nearly free.
I feel the light.
A little longer.
One push of wind and I swing.
It touched me.
I sway and nearly slip off the stem.
The landing is soft.
The grass catches me.

lines.zh: 我还在，蛹壳挂在叶脉上。
lines.en: I am still here, chrysalis hung on a leaf vein.
A corner of the shell has broken.
I curl up inside.
Cannot move.
Hanging under a leaf, waiting to change.
I have only just formed.
A new spot on the leaf.
I chose this leaf.
The wind blows from this side.
I am not dry yet.
Good sun here.

lines.zh: 我把身子慢慢收进蛹壳。
lines.en: I slowly draw myself into the cocoon.
It is noisy outside.

lines.zh: 壳里不动，外面已经变了。
lines.en: Still inside, while the world outside turns.
I will hang like this.
The fire makes my shell crackle.
I hit the ground and rolled once.
Water soaks through me and I sink.

lines.zh: 爆风把我连叶带丝掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast tore me off the leaf, silk and all.
An arrow grazes my shell and scrapes powder.
Inside the shell, I turn to liquid.
I live on what I stored.
The thunder rattles right through me.
I vanish from the leaf.
